name: Semiconductor Memory Design
description: This postgraduate elective course introduces the analysis and design of semiconductor memory systems including SRAM, DRAM, and non-volatile memories. Emphasis is placed on circuit-to-device-to-system understanding, circuit and layout design, timing optimization, integration and familiarity with VLSI backend CAD tools (virtuoso, HSPICE, DRC, LVS).
